Known for its durable construction, sleek design, and traveler-tested features, Travelpro luggage is a go-to among airline professionals and frequent flyers alike (our editors are big fans of the TravelPro Crew Classic carry-on, Platinum Elite Large Check-In Spinner, and Maxlite Air carry-on, in particular). From hard-shell spinners to modular soft-sided bags, there's an ideal piece for every trip—and with the right coupon, it’s more affordable than ever. Here are the best Travelpro coupons and luggage deals to score right now.

Get 10% off with a Travelpro discount code and today’s deals

Want to save 10% on your first Travelpro order? You’ve got options. First, sign up for Travelpro’s email newsletter to receive an exclusive one-time-use Travelpro promo code sent directly to your inbox—automatically generated and ready to apply at checkout. Prefer to text? Opt into Travelpro’s text alerts, and you’ll get a one-time 10% off Travelpro coupon via SMS.

On top of these sign-up perks, customers can also score an extra 10% off (with promo code UPGRADE10), giving you even more ways to save on premium luggage. And if you’re an existing customer who already owns a piece of Travelpro luggage, you’re eligible for additional savings too—simply request a single-use discount code through Travelpro’s dedicated page for returning customers.

Not only do these offers help you secure immediate discounts, but joining Travelpro’s email and text lists ensures you’re always first to know about limited-time deals and sitewide sales, including major savings events like Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
Get up to 30% off select items in the Travelpro sale without a coupon code

During Travelpro's ongoing sale, travelers can refresh their luggage collection for less with suitcases up to 30% off. I'm excited to see that the brand is offering 30% off its Platinum Elite carry-on (on sale for $279, marked down from $391). The one downside is these are final sale purchases, with no returns or exchanges allowed, so be sure to triple-check things like the item's size, color, and dimensions before hitting purchase.

Discounted items include carry-ons and duffels; most notably, the Maxlite 5 Compact carry-on in Orchid Pink is marked down from $170 to $127. The soft-sided carry-on is lightweight, durable, and both water- and stain-resistant. It also features a zippered front pocket for your laptop or small essentials, and interior compression straps that help you pack more. Travelpro's Platinum Elite Tri-Fold garment bag is also marked down right now. It's an ideal carry-on for business travelers or anyone headed to a destination wedding.
Get a mystery Travelpro discount code this month

If you visit the Travelpro website this month, you might receive a time-sensitive pop-up that prompts you to try your luck with a scratch-off. This leads to a mystery discount—which you can claim by adding your email address and phone number—usually between 10% and 30% off.
Get 10% off with the Travelpro military discount

Active military members and veterans can unlock an extra 10% off Travelpro luggage through the brand’s military discount program. To access the deal, verify your service status through ID.me—you’ll then receive a unique Travelpro coupon code to apply at checkout. It’s a year-round thank you for those who serve and protect, and it's available on top of other ongoing offers.
Discover Travelpro’s iconic luggage collections and gifts under $100

For thoughtful gifts or affordable upgrades, explore Travelpro’s travel essentials under $100. This season, you can save on tech-forward features and stylish colorways without overspending. From top-rated carry-ons to premium checked spinners, Travelpro’s luggage lineup consistently earns praise from travel editors and frequent flyers alike. Notable collections include the Platinum Elite Softside and Hardside lines, designed for business and frequent travelers with features like USB ports, self-aligning wheels, and built-in suit compartments; the Maxlite and Maxlite Air series, which offer lightweight durability for casual travelers; the modular and ultra-adaptable VersaPack+ system for organized packing; and the Crew Classic collection, featuring timeless softside styles tailored for professionals on the move.
Earn free shipping on orders over $150

The last thing you want to worry about when your online shopping is getting hit with hefty shipping fees. Luckily Travelpro offers free standard shipping on all US orders over $150. There's no code required—free shipping is automatically applied when you spend $150 or more. And if you're buying new luggage, it's likely you'll hit that threshold.
What to do if your Travelpro coupon code is not working

If your Travelpro promo code isn't working at checkout, there are a few simple ways to troubleshoot. First, double check that the code is spelled correctly with no extra spaces or typos. If that doesn't work, take a look at the exact details of the promo code to make sure it's still active and hasn't expired. Some discount codes have a minimum spend requirement, so you'll want to be sure your cart meets any necessary criteria to qualify. Another thing worth checking for is that you haven't already used a particular promo code and if it's valid for first-time shoppers only. If everything looks right and your Travelpro promo code still isn't working, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh. If all else fails, contact Travelpro's customer service for help.
